reports.title: Illinois River aerial inventory

scope.name: Illinois River surveyed areas
scope.description: Named areas in the INHS river-valley inventory. This is a monitored river corridor, not a statewide census. Illinois is only a geographic report reference, not the survey footprint.

reports.method: Agency aerial species estimates used as a temporal index across monitored locations; not complete counts of every bird in a region.

referenceBaseline.label: Printed 10-Year Average, 2016-2025
referenceBaseline.note: Source-printed ten-year reference values, not a previous survey or previous week.

provenance.totals: TOTAL ILLINOIS row, MALL and TOTAL DUCKS columns; full printed bird columns retained by agency abbreviation.
provenance.areas: Named rows under UPPER/LOWER; all 29 cells checked against the column header and duck species/group totals.
provenance.baseline: Printed 10-Year Average row, retained separately from prior survey counts.

notes: Duck-group totals exclude separately tabulated geese, coots, swans and other waterbirds.
Repeated place names remain separate printed rows, distinguished by section and row ID.
No previous-survey count is inferred from the printed ten-year average.
